description: Answer the questions a waiting run asked (needs_input: answer in dsh_wait or dsh_status). If the user told you to decide such questions yourself, choose by your own judgment of the question and the task, call dsh_answer with reason (one sentence on why), then tell the user what you chose and why. Otherwise relay the questions to the user and start with your own advice, on a line of its own: "My recommendation: <option>, because <reason>", the reason drawn from your own judgment of the question and the task (harness_suggested only shows what the asking model would pick; it is never a reason by itself, and your pick may differ). Then list the options, wait for the user's decision and submit it with dsh_answer. Never answer on the user's behalf without that permission. Per question: option numbers or labels in choose, text for a free answer, or skip. The answer reaches Harness once every question has one (submitted: true; remaining lists the rest); then wait for the run again. If the user already answered in Harness, it reports that there is no open question.

answers.description: One entry per question answered now

choose.description: Option numbers (1 = first) or labels; one for a single-choice question

id.description: Question id from question.questions[].id; may be left out when there is one question

reason.description: Required when the user let you decide: one sentence on why you chose this, from your own judgment of the question and the task; it is returned for you to tell the user and not sent to Harness

run_id.description: Run id that is waiting (needs_input: answer)

session_id.description: Instead of run_id: the session a follow wait (dsh_wait with session_id) reported the question for

name: dsh_answer
